name: abilian-sbe-tailwind-vite
description: Tailwind CSS build for Abilian SBE Flask templates

scripts.copy-assets: mkdir -p ../src/abilian/sbe/static/vite && cp dist/* ../src/abilian/sbe/static/vite/ && npm run copy-pdfjs
scripts.copy-pdfjs: V=$(node -p "require('./node_modules/pdfjs-dist/package.json').version") && D=../src/abilian/sbe/static/vite/pdfjs-$V && rm -rf ../src/abilian/sbe/static/vite/pdfjs ../src/abilian/sbe/static/vite/pdfjs-* && mkdir -p $D/wasm && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/build/pdf.worker.min.mjs $D/ && cp -R node_modules/pdfjs-dist/cmaps node_modules/pdfjs-dist/standard_fonts $D/ && cp node_modules/pdfjs-dist/wasm/*_nowasm_fallback.js $D/wasm/
